title: Swimmers and Rowboat on Lake with Decorative Border, 1920s Snapshot Photo
description: An atmospheric summer snapshot capturing figures enjoying an afternoon on the water, including a small rowboat and people swimming in a lake or river flanked by dense woodland. The right portion of the frame shows a partial overexposure or light leak. The photograph is encased in a charming Art Deco patterned decorative border featuring the 'SELKO' photo finisher imprint in all four corners, typical of 1920s amateur film processing in the United States.
